request.code: const errors=[];page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(String(e)));page.on('console',m=>{if(m.type()==='error')errors.push(m.text());});await page.setViewportSize({width:390,height:844});await page.reload();await page.waitForTimeout(900);if((await page.locator('#pause').innerText()).includes('계속'))await page.locator('#pause').click();await page.screenshot({path:'/Users/jongseoklee/Documents/ChatGPT/game-workspace/examples/star-canopy/evidence/campaign/plugin-012/mobile.png'});const state={errors,layout:await page.evaluate(()=>({viewport:innerWidth,width:document.body.scrollWidth})),resources:await page.evaluate(()=>performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter(e=>e.responseStatus>=400).map(e=>({url:e.name,status:e.responseStatus})))};if((await page.locator('#pause').innerText()).includes('쉬기'))await page.locator('#pause').click();return state;
